title: Reasons 13-16: miracles; societies; prophecy; best men's authority
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): YE THIRTEENTH from miracles that ye whole force belonging toward ye created universe exceed — therefore a cause surpassing ye universe there is. YE FOURTEENTH from conservation belonging toward economic, scholastic, political, plus ecclesiastical society which except by one all-powerful could not be kept. YE FIFTEENTH from predictions belonging toward future things plus their fulfillment. YE SIXTEENTH from ye best men's authority — Moses, Prophets, Apostles, plus better philosophers. But that is God.
pass_b_english: THE THIRTEENTH REASON is founded on miracles that exceed the whole force of the created universe. Therefore there is a cause that surpasses the universe. But that is God.
THE FOURTEENTH REASON is founded on the conservation of economic, scholastic, political, and ecclesiastical society, which could not be kept except by one all-powerful. But that one is God.
THE FIFTEENTH REASON is founded on predictions of future things and their fulfillment (Isaiah 41:22-23).
THE SIXTEENTH REASON is founded on the authority of the best men: Moses, the Prophets, the Apostles, and the better philosophers proved it by miracles, holiness, martyrdom, and prophecy.
source_text: RATIO DECIMA TERTIA fundatur in miraculis quae totam creati universi vim excedunt. Ergo causa est quae universum exsuperet. At illa est Deus. RATIO DECIMA QUARTA fundatur in societatis oeconomicae, scholasticae, politicae, ecclesiasticae conservatione, quae nisi ab uno praepotente servari non posset. At ille est Deus. RATIO DECIMA QUINTA fundatur in praedictionibus rerum futurarum & earum impletione, Esa. 41.22-23. RATIO DECIMA SEXTA fundatur in optimorum hominum autoritate: Moses, Prophetae, Apostoli, melioresque philosophi miraculis, sanctitate, martyrio, prophetia probarunt.
